s.how: Slice a loaf of Italian bread thickly and toast under a hot grill until golden at the edges. Rub each slice with a cut garlic clove, drizzle with olive oil and scatter with chopped parsley and grated parmesan. Serve in the alley behind the restaurant.

s.note: Cured meats, olives and bread for two, at the candlelit table set for Lady and Tramp.
s.how: Fold 150g salami and slices of provolone onto a board. Add kalamata olives, marinated artichoke hearts and strips of roasted red capsicum. Tear a loaf of Italian bread beside it. Set it out for two by candlelight.

m.note: The famous spaghetti dinner behind Tony's.
m.how: Mix 300g beef mince and 300g pork mince with parmesan, parsley and an egg, roll into balls and brown. Add 2 cans crushed tomatoes and torn basil and simmer 40 minutes. Pile over 500g spaghetti on one big plate. Leave the last meatball for your date.

w.note: Cannoli piped with ricotta for the beautiful night at Tony's.
w.how: Drain 500g ricotta overnight, then beat with 80g icing sugar, orange zest and 50g candied orange peel. Spoon into a piping bag and fill 12 cannoli shells just before serving. Dip each end in crushed pistachios.

d.note: Blood orange syrup and cold soda, poured while Joe serenades the dinner out the back.
d.how: Simmer 80g caster sugar, 80ml water and 2 rosemary sprigs for 3 minutes, then cool and strain. In a jug, mix 500ml blood orange juice with the rosemary syrup and the juice of 1 lemon. Fill 4 glasses with ice, pour in the juice to halfway and top with soda water. Garnish each with a blood orange slice and a small rosemary sprig.
